name: pvc_bound_no_pod_attached
row_template: *ClusterName:* {k8s_cluster} | Namespace: {namespace} | PVC: {persistentvolumeclaim} | Bound but no pod attached for >24h
description: Info: PVC has been Bound (disk provisioned) but not attached to any running pod for more than 24 hours. Common causes: StatefulSet scaled to 0, deployment deleted without PVC cleanup, or orphaned dev volume. Review and delete if no longer needed to reduce storage costs.
